تكربنت (form IIq)
# تَكَرْبَنْتُ (takarbantu) /ta.kar.ban.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَكَرْبَنَ (takarbana)
# تَكَرْبَنْتَ (takarbanta) /ta.kar.ban.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَرْبَنَ (takarbana)
# تَكَرْبَنْتِ (takarbanti) /ta.kar.ban.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَرْبَنَ (takarbana)
# تَكَرْبَنَتْ (takarbanat) /ta.kar.ba.nat/: t
